gloss: to despair; to lose all hope

definitions.gloss: to despair; to lose all hope
definitions.explanation: To feel that there is no hope left, often in response to a devastating situation or repeated failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{絶望|ぜつぼう}した。
⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{絶望|ぜつぼう}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: No matter how many times you fail, you must not lose hope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無力|むりょく}→無力：13419_muryoku⟧さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{絶望|ぜつぼう}して、すべて⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げ{出|だ}した→投げ出す：10589_nagedasu⟧。
examples.english: He despaired at his own powerlessness and threw everything away.
Even in the midst of despair, there is a ray of hope.

notes:
A strong, dramatic word. The pattern is 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{絶望|ぜつぼう}する (to despair at/over something). The noun ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}→絶望：04863_zetsubou⟧ (despair) is equally common, often paired with ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧ (hope) as its opposite.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}{的|てき}→絶望的：15404_zetsubouteki⟧な: hopeless, desperate
- ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}{感|かん}→絶望感：17802_zetsuboukan⟧: feeling of despair
- ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}→絶望：04863_zetsubou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{淵|ふち}→淵：13456_fuchi⟧: the brink of despair
- ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}→絶望：04863_zetsubou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧: the depths of despair
- ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}→絶望：04863_zetsubou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{立|た}ち{直|なお}る→立ち直る：15049_tachinaoru⟧: to recover from despair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{失望|しつぼう}する→失望する：21757_shitsubousuru⟧: to be disappointed — much milder; implies unfulfilled expectations rather than total hopelessness
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up — implies acceptance rather than emotional devastation
- ⟦{落胆|らくたん}する→落胆する：20331_rakutansuru⟧: to be discouraged — temporary discouragement, less extreme than despair
